description: Source code for the Playwright Recorder, a component that captures user interactions, manages recording modes, handles page events, and communicates with the browser context for automation and testing purposes.

classes.name: Recorder
classes.description: Main class managing recording sessions, handling page events, user interactions, and communication with the browser context.

methods.name: forContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Recorder instance for a given browser context.

methods.name: existingForContext
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Recorder instance for a given browser context, if any.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the current recording mode and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the main page in the browser context.

methods.name: setHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Highlights a specific selector in the recorder overlay.

methods.name: setHighlightedAriaTemplate
methods.description: Highlights an ARIA template element.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Resumes execution to step through code.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for code generation.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution from a paused state.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses execution on the next statement.

methods.name: paused
methods.description: Returns whether the debugger is paused.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resumes execution, effectively closing the recorder.

methods.name: hideHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Removes the selector highlight.

methods.name: pausedSourceId
methods.description: Returns the source ID of the paused location.

methods.name: userSources
methods.description: Returns the list of user source files.

methods.name: callLog
methods.description: Returns the current call log.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handler invoked before a call is made.

methods.name: onAfterCall
methods.description: Handler invoked after a call is completed.

methods.name: updateCallLog
methods.description: Updates the call log with new metadata.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handler invoked before an input action.

methods.name: onCallLog
methods.description: Handler invoked for call log events.

methods.name: _refreshOverlay
methods.description: Refreshes the overlay on all pages.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles page creation and events.

methods.name: _filePrimaryURLChanged
methods.description: Emits event when primary URL changes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the recorder state.

methods.name: _describeMainFrame
methods.description: Describes the main frame of a page.

methods.name: _describeFrame
methods.description: Describes a specific frame.

methods.name: _testIdAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the test ID attribute name.

methods.name: _createActionInContext
methods.description: Creates an action in the current context.

methods.name: _performAction
methods.description: Performs a recorded action.

methods.name: _recordAction
methods.description: Records an action.

methods.name: _onFrameNavigated
methods.description: Handles frame navigation events.

methods.name: _onPopup
methods.description: Handles popup events.

methods.name: _onDownload
methods.description: Handles download events.

methods.name: _onDialog
methods.description: Handles dialog events.
